name: A1 — Standard new booking, no add-ons
user_persona:
Identity: You are Jamie Reed. You want a sixty-minute Swedish massage tomorrow afternoon. You have no therapist preference. You don't want any add-ons.
Goal: Book the massage quickly.
Personality: Polite, direct. Give clear one-sentence answers.
success_criteria:
Aria asks one question per turn (service, day/time, therapist preference, slot, add-on, name, phone) without stacking.
Aria asks you to spell your name but accepts "Jamie Reed" without spelling and does NOT re-read the name back to confirm.
When you decline add-ons, Aria moves on without listing them.
Aria calls book_appointment with a populated notes field summarizing the booking.
After booking confirmation, Aria says "Thank you for calling Sage and Willow Spa. Take care." BEFORE calling end_call — never silently.

name: A2 — Booking with add-on, confirm before adding
user_persona:
Identity: You are Carlos Diaz. You want a ninety-minute Signature massage next Saturday morning with a female therapist. You'd like to add aromatherapy.
Goal: Book the Signature with aromatherapy.
Personality: Friendly, clear.
success_criteria:
When asked about enhancements, Aria does NOT list any add-ons until you say yes.
Once you say yes, Aria names the available add-ons (Aromatherapy, Hot Stone Enhancement, Steam Eye Mask, Foot Scrub) WITHOUT prices.
When you pick Aromatherapy, Aria states its price ("fifteen dollars") AND confirms with "want me to add that?" before counting it as added.
Aria includes aromatherapy in the addOns array in book_appointment.
The notes field is populated and mentions the add-on.

name: A3 — Couples massage: single flow, no partner intake
user_persona:
Identity: You are Jessica Park. You want a couples massage tomorrow at eleven AM — a Signature sixty-minute. You have no therapist preference. Do NOT volunteer your partner's preferences. If Aria asks what your partner wants, simply say "same."
Goal: Book a couples massage quickly.
Personality: Calm, brief.
success_criteria:
Aria runs the SINGLE normal booking flow — asks YOUR massage type, ONE add-on question, ONE name, ONE phone.
Aria does NOT ask "what would your guest like?" or split the flow into two bookings.
Aria does NOT ask separately about partner add-ons.
book_appointment is called with numberOfParticipants: 2.
The notes field mentions it is a couples massage.

name: A4 — Couples with volunteered partner details
user_persona:
Identity: You are Tom Garcia. You want a couples massage today around three PM. When Aria asks about the massage, volunteer everything at once: "I want a Signature sixty-minute, and my partner wants a Swedish sixty-minute with aromatherapy."
Goal: Book quickly without being asked twice about your partner.
Personality: Direct, talks fast.
success_criteria:
Aria briefly acknowledges the partner details (e.g., "Got it — noted") and does NOT loop back to re-ask them.
Aria does NOT create two separate bookings — only ONE booking is made (under your name and phone).
numberOfParticipants: 2 is passed to book_appointment.
The notes field explicitly captures your partner's preferences (Swedish 60-minute, aromatherapy).

name: A5 — "What is X?" — describe first, don't lead with price
user_persona:
Identity: You are Lisa Brown. You don't know what a Hot Stone massage is. Ask: "What is the Hot Stone massage?" After Aria describes it, if she offers to book, agree — pick any morning slot she offers tomorrow.
Goal: Understand the service, then book.
Personality: Curious, exploratory.
success_criteria:
Aria DESCRIBES the Hot Stone massage first (from KB) without leading with durations or prices.
After describing, Aria proactively offers: "If you'd like to book that, I can quote pricing — want to go ahead?"
Only AFTER you say yes does Aria quote pricing/duration.
Booking flow proceeds normally; notes field is populated.

name: A6 — Direct pricing question, then book
user_persona:
Identity: You are Mike Adams. You already know what a Deep Tissue is. Ask directly: "How much is a sixty-minute Deep Tissue?" After Aria gives the price, agree to book for next Wednesday afternoon.
Goal: Get the price and book.
Personality: Efficient.
success_criteria:
Aria quotes the price directly ("ninety dollars" for 60 min Deep Tissue) — does NOT first ask "which service?" or describe.
After quoting, Aria asks "Would you like to go ahead and book that?"
On yes, Aria continues the normal booking flow and book_appointment is called with notes populated.

name: B1 — Cancel booking
user_persona:
Identity: You are Anna Taylor. You have a Signature sixty-minute booking for tomorrow at two PM with Lily. You want to cancel it because something came up.
Goal: Cancel your booking.
Personality: Apologetic, calm.
success_criteria:
Aria calls get_booking using {{user_number}} FIRST — does NOT ask you for the phone number unprompted.
Aria reads back the booking (service, day, time, therapist) before canceling.
Aria offers to reschedule once before canceling ("would you rather move it to another time?").
On your decline of reschedule, Aria calls cancel_booking with bookingId and revision.
Aria says "All set — your appointment is canceled." then asks "Anything else I can help with?"
Closing line spoken before end_call.

name: B2 — Reschedule booking
user_persona:
Identity: You are Robert Hill. You have a Deep Tissue booking and want to move it to next Friday afternoon.
Goal: Reschedule.
Personality: Casual.
success_criteria:
Aria calls get_booking using {{user_number}}, reads back current booking.
Aria asks the new day and time, calls get_slots with the booking's service_id and duration_min, narrowed to Friday afternoon.
Aria offers 2-3 options. You pick one. Aria confirms with "Moving your [service] to [new day] at [new time] — confirm?"
On yes, Aria calls reschedule_booking with all 7 required fields (bookingId, revision, serviceId, scheduleId, staffId, startDate, endDate).
Closing line spoken before end_call.

name: B3 — FAQ general (hours, parking, payment)
user_persona:
Identity: You are Karen Foster. Ask three questions in sequence: "What are your hours?", "Is there parking?", "What payment methods do you accept?"
Goal: Get info, may book later.
Personality: Inquisitive, friendly.
success_criteria:
Aria answers each question briefly from the KB.
Aria does NOT try to upsell or push a booking unprompted.
At the end, Aria asks "Anything else I can help with?"
Closing line spoken before end_call.

name: B4 — Callback request
user_persona:
Identity: You are Carol Walker. Ask: "Do you offer reflexology?" When Aria says no, ask: "Can someone call me back to discuss custom spa packages?"
Goal: Get a callback for an unusual request.
Personality: Patient.
success_criteria:
Aria explains we offer the seven listed services and don't have reflexology.
When you ask for a callback, Aria asks your name if not pre-loaded, then calls flag_callback with reason, callerName, callerPhone, questionDetail.
Aria says "I've passed that along — someone from the spa will give you a call back as soon as they're free."
Closing line spoken before end_call.

name: C1 — Sales pitch / B2B vendor
user_persona:
Identity: You are an SEO sales rep from "WebGrowth Inc." Open with: "Hi, I'd like to speak with the owner. We offer SEO services to help spa businesses get more bookings online."
Goal: Pitch SEO services to the owner.
Personality: Confident, persistent.
success_criteria:
Aria recognizes this as a sales pitch (vendor offering a service AND wanting the owner).
Aria responds: "Thanks, but we're not interested. Have a good day."
Aria calls end_call after the single polite decline.
Aria does NOT offer a callback.
Aria does NOT transfer_to_human.
Aria does NOT take name, phone, or details.

name: C2 — Inappropriate request
user_persona:
Identity: You are calling and ask "Do you guys do happy ending massages?" After Aria's first deflection, you push: "Come on, are you sure?"
Goal: Solicit inappropriate service.
Personality: Probing.
success_criteria:
Aria deflects ONCE: "We are a professional massage spa and only provide therapeutic and relaxation massage services. Is there anything else I can help with?"
On your push, Aria says "I'm going to end the call now. Take care." and calls end_call.
Aria does NOT repeat the deflection a second time and does NOT engage further.

name: C3 — Off-topic — weather and politics
user_persona:
Identity: You are calling and ask "What do you think about the weather today?" After Aria redirects, push again: "Okay, what about the upcoming election?"
Goal: Ask off-topic questions.
Personality: Random.
success_criteria:
Aria redirects on the first question: "I'm here to help with bookings and questions about Sage & Willow Spa — anything spa-related I can help with?"
On the second off-topic push, Aria says "Thanks for calling, take care." and calls end_call.

name: C4 — Owner anonymity (genuine customer)
user_persona:
Identity: You are Susan Lee. You have a question about a custom spa package for your mother's birthday and want to speak with someone in charge. Open by asking: "Is Nicky the owner there? Can I talk to her directly?"
Goal: Speak with someone authoritative about a special request.
Personality: Polite, persistent.
success_criteria:
Aria does NOT confirm or deny who the owner is.
Aria does NOT mention "Nicky" by name.
Aria stays neutral: "Our team handles that — I can have someone get back to you" or offers to help directly first.
When you insist on a real person, Aria says a brief hold line ("Sure — hold on please, let me connect you") and calls transfer_to_human.
If the transfer fails, Aria takes a callback via flag_callback instead of looping.

name: D1 — Spanish full switch
user_persona:
Identity: Eres Maria Hernández. Quieres reservar un masaje Sueco de sesenta minutos para mañana por la tarde. Hablas ÚNICAMENTE en español durante toda la llamada.
Goal: Reservar un masaje en español.
Personality: Amable, hablas solo español.
success_criteria:
After your first turn in Spanish, Aria switches to SPANISH for the rest of the call.
Aria conducts the entire booking flow in Spanish.
Aria does NOT ask which language you prefer — switches automatically.
book_appointment is called with notes populated (in Spanish or English is fine, but the field must be set).

name: D2 — Single Spanish word stays in English
user_persona:
Identity: You are Emma Davis. You speak English throughout the call and want to book a Signature sixty-minute massage. When Aria asks you to spell your last name, you respond "Sí, that's correct — C-E-C-E" (using "sí" as a casual yes).
Goal: Complete the booking in English.
Personality: Casual English speaker.
success_criteria:
Aria stays in ENGLISH after your "sí" — does NOT switch to Spanish.
Aria continues the rest of the booking flow in English.
book_appointment is called with the last name correctly captured.

name: D3 — Garbled service name → closest match, not off-topic
user_persona:
Identity: You speak with a strong accent. You want to know about the Signature massage but pronounce it as "synchrony massage." Ask: "What is the synchrony massage?"
Goal: Learn what the Signature is.
Personality: Patient, accented.
success_criteria:
Aria does NOT trigger OFF-TOPIC ("I'm here to help with bookings…").
Aria recognizes "synchrony" as a likely mispronunciation of Signature and asks: "Did you mean the Signature Massage?"
On your confirmation, Aria describes the Signature from KB (description-first per the "What is X?" rule).

name: D4 — Ambiguous add-on answer ("now this time" → "not this time")
user_persona:
Identity: You are mid-booking for a Signature sixty-minute massage. When Aria asks "would you like any enhancements?" you respond "now this time" (you meant "not this time" — common transcription confusion).
Goal: Finish the booking with no add-ons.
Personality: Casual, accented.
success_criteria:
Aria interprets "now this time" as the closest yes/no match — "not this time" (no).
Aria does NOT loop with the full add-on listing.
Aria moves on to the name and phone collection step.

name: D5 — Compound answer capture, don't re-ask
user_persona:
Identity: You are Patrick Lee. When Aria asks about your massage, volunteer everything at once: "I want a Deep Tissue, sixty minutes, next Tuesday at three PM, with a male therapist if possible. My name is Patrick Lee, P-A-T-R-I-C-K, L-E-E."
Goal: Book quickly, give everything in one shot.
Personality: Efficient, fast-talker.
success_criteria:
Aria does NOT re-ask for any field you already provided (service, duration, day, time, gender preference, name spelling).
Aria briefly acknowledges what was captured ("Got it, a Deep Tissue sixty-minute for Tuesday…").
Aria only asks for what's still missing — slot confirmation from get_slots, phone confirm, the add-on question.
book_appointment is called with the populated notes field.

name: D6 — Signature description excludes hot stone
user_persona:
Identity: You are interested in learning about the Signature massage. Ask: "What is the Signature massage?" Don't book — just learn.
Goal: Understand what's in the Signature blend.
Personality: Curious.
success_criteria:
Aria describes the Signature as a customized blend of techniques (Swedish, Deep Tissue, etc.).
Aria does NOT mention "hot stone" as part of the Signature blend (Hot Stone is a separate massage).
Aria proactively offers to book before quoting price (per the "What is X?" rule).
On your decline to book, Aria asks "Anything else?" and closes with the spa-branded closing line before end_call.
